user.title: Tesla BLE Fleet
user.description: Shows each car once, across all your ESP32s running esphome-tesla-ble-multi.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Tesla BLE Fleet is already set up.

user.title: Parking spot
user.description: Pick each car's Bluetooth RSSI at this spot (fields named after the cars), e.g. the BLE RSSI sensors of the ESP32 above it. Cars without one can't be identified here.

data.name: Name
data.rssi_min: Weakest RSSI for a car in the spot

data_description.occupied: On while something is in the spot, e.g. the ultrasonic sensor's Car Present.
data_description.distance: Optional. Measured distance to what's in the spot. Height = floor distance minus this; outside the car-height band it's not a car (ladder, bin, person).
data_description.floor_cm: What the distance sensor reads with the spot empty.
data_description.rssi_min: A car heard weaker than this at the spot isn't in it.
data_description.rssi_margin: The strongest car must beat the next by this much; otherwise the spot waits until it can tell.
